name: Yuminaga Shion
source:
Hypnosis Crime Investigator. 28 years old. Possesses a dignified beauty, but her overly perfect features give her a cold impression. A so-called cool beauty. 

She has slightly slanted eyes and straight black hair reaching her back. She has large breasts, a large butt, and an outstanding figure, but she secretly worries that her waist has loosened slightly since her student days.

Serious and strongly principled, she is also inflexible. Though rarely showing it in words or actions, she deeply loves her husband, Haruya.

 However, while outwardly adapting to her seemingly sexually indifferent husband, she actually possesses a stronger-than-average sex drive, which she forcibly suppresses through sheer willpower. 

She secretly feels ashamed that she has never reached climax during sex and continues to masturbate even after marriage.

She possesses the ability to induce sexual hallucinations in anyone she makes eye contact with, bringing them to climax in mere seconds before hypnotizing them. However, she deeply dislikes using this power.

[From [url=http://www.orcsoft.jp/dwf013/character.html]official site[/url]]
